channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Photos show empty supermarket shelves as millions across the US brace for Winter Storm Fern
item.description: Ice, snow, and dangerous wind chills could affect millions of people across 35 states this weekend. Photos show how Americans are preparing for the storm.

item.title: Amazon expected to cut thousands more corporate jobs soon
item.description: Amazon plans major cuts impacting thousands of corporate employees, following a previous round of job cuts in October.

item.title: Lululemon says people who buy their sheer leggings should wear skin-toned undies and size up
item.description: Lululemon has an interesting fix for its see-through "Get Low" tights problem — wear flesh-colored underwear.

item.title: OpenAI is making more than $1 billion a month from something that has nothing to do with ChatGPT
item.description: Sam Altman says OpenAI added more than $1 billion in annual recurring revenue in a month, driven by its API business rather than ChatGPT.

item.title: Airlines are canceling flights ahead of a massive winter storm. Here's what to do if your flight is delayed or canceled.
item.description: A severe winter storm has prompted US airlines to cancel flights, issue travel waivers, and advise passengers on refund and rebooking options.

item.title: Meta's former chief scientist Yann LeCun says he hated being a manager: 'I'm much more visionary'
item.description: LeCun said he prefers focusing on innovation over leadership duties.

item.title: The TikTok deal is done. Here's what will change and what will stay the same.
item.description: TikTok has closed a joint-venture deal for its US business, handing over some operational control to an investor group.

item.title: Russia can build 500 Iranian-designed Shahed drones in a single day, Zelenskyy says
item.description: Zelenskyy said his country's 1,000 daily interceptor drones are "still not enough," even at a 2:1 manufacturing ratio against Russia's Shaheds.

item.title: Goldie Hawn, 80, credits one thing with making her relationship with Kurt Russell last 42 years
item.description: Goldie Hawn, who has been married twice before, said she's learned that traditional ideas of partnership don't work for her.

item.title: Elon Musk says subscription prices for Full Self-Driving mode are going up as Tesla kills Autopilot
item.description: He said the subscription price, currently $99, will rise as the FSD's capabilities improve.
